summary: Adopt the FCC public-domain unwanted-call source
description: Record the FCC Socrata dataset contract, public-domain reuse basis, exact allowed fields, unverified-complaint semantics, freshness, correction, and takedown behavior.
acceptance: The canonical source registry, FCC manifest, and caller-service index prove the FCC dataset is current, anonymously API-accessible, and licensed as Public Domain U.S. Government.
Only caller-ID number, issue date, and call/message type are permitted inputs; ticket IDs, advertiser numbers, reporter location, ZIP code, issue time, method, and narratives are forbidden.

The contract states that complaints are consumer-selected and unverified, defines correction/takedown and freshness behavior, and never equates an FCC row with an official warning, verified caller, harmfulness, or safety.
verification: uv run pytest tests/contracts -q && make check
